answer: We model a Sybil-resistant protocol where identity creation requires dynamic opportunity-cost collateral validated via zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, generating a subgame-perfect slashing matrix. If an adversary attempts identity multiplication within the onyx validator tier, their pseudonymous nodes wander into strictly negative expected attack utility through accelerated collateral destruction. Slashing these unbonded ivory assets guarantees that honest staking forms a robust Nash equilibrium under arbitrary capital constraints.
